question: What happens when the circle is contemplated in the outer hand and what sign indicates imminent death?
premises: When contemplated and seen in the outer hand, one becomes a samaya-initiate.
Agitation of the bonds and similar signs may appear immediately.
Such signs indicate that the person is about to depart upward.
inference: The outer-hand contemplation confers samaya status, but bond-agitation can signal that the subject is near death.
uncertainties: The object of tam in the next verse is anticipated here and remains slightly open.
plain_english: When this is contemplated and seen in the outer hand, one becomes a samaya-initiate; but if agitation of the bonds and the like appears at once, that shows the person is about to depart.
